sources_read.section: §5.4 Capture, input and import (highlight capture, two layers per page); §5.6 Export and traceability (slug format h-p{page:02}-{order:02}-{6}); RULE-16, RULE-17

scope: Text-layer highlight capture (Selection/Range over the PDF.js text layer), slug generation, persistence through the existing insertHighlight() repository call, and a highlight-layer canvas leaf that draws stored highlights from the live query. Out of scope: editing highlight geometry in place (RULE-16); capturing text from the Konva layer; region/OCR highlights (011); notes (012).

acceptance_criteria.text: Same text and rect always give the same slug.
Row and outbox op land together.
Drawing goes through the painter only (I17).
Automated test at three zoom levels and after rotation.

open_questions: NEW-1 (defaulted) -- The slug format h-p{page:02}-{order:02}-{6} (spec 5.6) does not define how `order` is computed, and spec 5.6 requires it to be deterministic so re-importing the same document dedupes. Insertion order is not deterministic across sessions (two different sessions could create the same two highlights in a different order). Default taken: `order` is the 1-based reading-order rank (sort by rect.y, then rect.x) among the highlights already known to exist on that page at creation time, computed from the local live query, not from a counter. This is a technical default at the implementation-detail level, not a product decision, so it is recorded here rather than escalated; flag for review if group/leader-import (011, 021) later needs a different ordering rule.

NEW-2 (naming, resolved from existing code, not escalated) -- The plan doc's g3 says `repository.createHighlight()`; the entities kernel (task 006/007) already ships `insertHighlight()` with the same shape (extraction defaults to 'text_layer', layer forced to 'individual', writes row+outbox in one transaction). This task calls the existing function rather than adding a second one with a different name.
risks: The most likely task to overrun (tasks §4): coordinates across zoom, rotation and re-render. Mitigated by reusing shared/utils/geometry.ts unchanged from task 009 rather than adding new coordinate math beyond the one new client-rect -> normalized-rect conversion.
Viewport pixels in bbox -- the bug that appears weeks later on another tablet (db §4.2). Mitigated by never storing a client rect; only the normalized rect crosses into insertHighlight().
highlights.bbox is a loosely typed generated Json column -- a local Bbox type plus a runtime shape check at the write boundary catches a malformed value before it reaches the repository.

Multi-line text selections produce multiple client rects per highlight -- flattened into one highlight with several rects in bbox.rects, per spec 5.4's QuadPoints precedent for leader import (011) even though 011 itself is out of scope here.
